question: Should stopped sessions allow only exact structured-event replays during the existing five-minute credential window, rejecting all new event history immediately after stop?
rationale: The change closes residual write authority and prevents terminal history mutation, but it deliberately narrows an existing documented producer contract and therefore requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt replay-only access
options.body: Reject new terminal events immediately after stop while allowing exact idempotent retries for five minutes.

options.title: Define controlled append access
options.body: Preserve post-stop event creation only through a separately reviewed capability with explicit authorization and compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Adopt replay-only access
recommendation.body: Reject new terminal events immediately after stop while allowing exact idempotent retries for five minutes.
